form_name: Application for Resident Address Update / Correction
purpose: Used to officially request an update or correction to your residential address on record. Requires valid proof of residence and identity verification.

fields.meaning: Your complete legal name as registered on official identity documents.
fields.what_to_fill: Write in BLOCK LETTERS exactly as printed on your government photo ID. Do not use abbreviations or initials.

fields.meaning: Your official date of birth for identity cross-verification.
fields.what_to_fill: Enter in DD/MM/YYYY format matching your birth certificate or primary photo ID.

fields.meaning: The previous residential address currently registered in the database.
fields.what_to_fill: Include flat/house number, street, locality, district, state, and 6-digit PIN code.

fields.meaning: The complete address where you currently reside and want to receive correspondence.
fields.what_to_fill: Ensure every line matches your accompanying Address Proof document word-for-word.

fields.meaning: Active contact details to receive verification OTPs and application tracking alerts.
fields.what_to_fill: Provide a 10-digit mobile number currently in your possession to complete verification.

fields.meaning: Legal declaration certifying that all provided details and proofs are genuine.
fields.what_to_fill: Sign cleanly strictly inside the designated border. Signatures extending past boundaries will be flagged.

documents_needed: Government-issued Photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport / Driving Licence)
Valid Address Proof for New Address (Electricity Bill / Rent Agreement / Bank Passbook under 3 months old)
Active Mobile Number (Capable of receiving SMS OTP verification)
common_mistakes: Name spelling mismatch between the form and attached ID proof.
Providing an address proof older than 3 months (utility bills must be recent).
Signing outside or across the designated signature bounding box.
Submitting blurry, cropped, or partially obscured document photocopies.
Leaving mandatory fields blank instead of writing 'N/A' if not applicable.
steps: Prepare self-attested photocopies of your valid photo ID and recent address proof.
Complete the form in legible BLOCK LETTERS using black or dark blue ballpoint ink.
Affix your recent passport-size photograph securely in the top-right box.
Carefully review all entries against your supporting documents before signing.
Submit the dossier at your nearest authorized enrollment centre and collect your stamped Acknowledgement Receipt with tracking URN.
